enEffect: When you kill witches and zombie villagers, nearby villagers' favor toward you increases by 1 point.
Whenever you use this item to kill a villager, this item's repair penalty is reset to zero and 10 points of durability are restored.

Killing a villager has a 10% * total enchantment level chance to drop 1 emerald and a 2% * total enchantment level chance to drop 1 gold ingot, and the "Hero of the Village" buff will no longer apply to you.
Grants you a random-level, constantly refreshing "Hero of the Village " buff in the evening.

When you land next to a villager, there is a certain chance to randomly steal 0-3 items from his trade list, but this can never exceed half the number of entries in the trade list. This enchantment performs three steal checks, each stealing one item; the higher the landing height, the greater the chance. When jumping down from a height of 5 blocks, the success rates are 30%|15%|5% respectively; when jumping down from a height of 15 blocks, the success rates are 80%|40%|20% respectively. Likewise, however, you have a minimum 30% and maximum 80% chance to deal 1-6 points of damage to the villager (the damage chance varies with landing height). If this enchantment effect takes place, each successful theft costs 30 points of boot durability.
